subject: Credible intervals for response other than 95%

messages.author: 642793e0109b8c57
messages.subject: Credible intervals for response other than 95%
parts:
Dear INLA experts,

How to get a credible interval for the response variable other than 95% (i.e., 98 or 99%)? I know that for 95% credibility we can use:

res_low <- mod$summary.fitted.values$"0.025quant"

res_high <- mod$summary.fitted.values$"0.975quant"

Is it possible also to use Quantiles 0.01 &  0.99 (98% credibility) or 0.005 & 0.995 (99% credibility)? How to do this?

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Credible intervals for response other than 95%
parts:
you can either use

inla.qmarginal()

on a marginal to get the quantiles, or use another set of default
quantiles,

> summary(inla(y ~ 1, data=data.frame(y=0), quantiles=c(0.1,0.2,0.3)))

Fixed effects:
mean sd 0.1quant 0.2quant 0.3quant mode kld
(Intercept) 0 0.012 -0.011 -0.006 -0.004 0 0.054

Model hyperparameters:
mean sd 0.1quant
0.2quant
Precision for the Gaussian observations 19984.51 19913.15 2207.92
4553.83
0.3quant mode
Precision for the Gaussian observations 7222.95 215.27

Marginal log-Likelihood: -0.078
is computed
Posterior summaries for the linear predictor and the fitted values are
computed
(Posterior marginals needs also
'control.compute=list(return.marginals.predictor=TRUE)')

messages.author: 642793e0109b8c57
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Credible intervals for response other than 95%
parts:
Hi Håvard, thanks for the quick answer! Indeed the additional arguments in the call to function inla() did the job, i.e:

quantiles=c(0.01,0.5,0.99), # for 98% credibility

or

quantiles=c(0.005,0.5,0.995), # for 99% credibility

All the best, Ismael.
